ATK +80% , ASPD +20 , attacks has 30% chance to increase its damage to 130% of ATK. Upon Skill activation, seeks a ground target within nearby tiles. If the said tile is deployable, move to its tile. If an elite/boss enemy is defeated or if Bellone did not attack for 1 second, he will seek another target. When Lethal Damage is taken, Bellone will not retreat but instead will end skill. When skill ends, Bellone returns to his original position

stages.effectText: Blocks 1 enemy; Gains +10 ASPD when above 50% HP

Attacks reduce the target's DEF by 7% for 10 seconds, stacks up to 5 times. Additionally, Bellone's damage increases as the target's HP decreases, reaching a maximum of 142% bonus damage when the target is below 20% HP.

Attacks reduce the target's DEF by 8% for 10 seconds, stacks up to 5 times. Additionally, Bellone's damage increases as the target's HP decreases, reaching a maximum of 142% bonus damage when the target is below 20% HP.
